description: This Java class defines the `ClusterRoleStatus` which encapsulates the status of an Akka cluster role, including reachable and unreachable members, and the leader of that role. It provides methods for creating instances, accessors, JSON serialization, and overrides for equality and string representation.

classes.name: ClusterRoleStatus
classes.description: Immutable class representing the status of a specific Akka cluster role, including reachable and unreachable members and an optional leader. Implements Jsonifiable for JSON serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ClusterRoleStatus instance with specified role, reachable and unreachable members, and leader.

methods.name: getReachable
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of reachable members.

methods.name: getUnreachable
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of unreachable members.

methods.name: getLeader
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the leader's address if present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ClusterRoleStatus to a JSON object, including reachable, unreachable, and leader fields.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on reachable, unreachable, role, and leader fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the fields.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
